name: Arms Depot

Will not be replaced by automated units

name: Omni Resource Generator
uniques: Can be built outside your borders
Gain control over [all] tiles in a [2]-tile radius
Tile provides yield without assigned population
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+50 Gold]
Will not be replaced by automated units

civilopediaText.text: Construct with a Super Cheat Worker to supply +50 of EACH strategic, luxury, and bonus resource, as long as the improvement remains active on an owned tile.
Supply is not an accumulating stockpile. Another Omni Resource Generator on a different owned tile supplies an additional 50 of each resource.
Works as a resource-producing improvement, not as natural resource deposits. Extra luxury copies are useful for trade but do not multiply happiness.
The improvement replaces any existing improvement on the tile; do not place it on a unique improvement you want to retain.

name: Magalanadu Strategic Fabricator - Horses
uniques: Will not be replaced by automated units
Comment [Resource synthesizer: supplies copies of this resource from the tile. Does not create a natural resource deposit.]

civilopediaText.text: Fabricates 8 Horses for the owner while this tile improvement is active.
May be placed on supported land, sea, ice, forest, jungle, marsh, oasis and mountain tiles. Not on city centers or natural wonders.

This is a tile improvement, not a natural deposit. Building another improvement on the same tile replaces this one. The usual resource icons and revealed-technology restrictions on natural deposits do not apply.
